_meta.adr: ADR-037 modular register fragment — never edit shillinq_register.json
_meta.description: T3 governance: subsidie administratie & verantwoording. Adds the SubsidieVerantwoording (accountability record) and AuditorStatement (auditor verification) schemas with declarative lifecycles (ADR-031), state-change notifications (ADR-031), and cross-schema approval/threshold guards (ADR-031 exception-path). Merged additively onto the monolith via ConfigFileLoaderService:deepMergeConfig (ADR-037).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of an Audit Finding Template is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

AuditFindingTemplate.title: Audit Finding Template
AuditFindingTemplate.description: Reusable audit-finding category with a default severity and remediation template, used when an auditor adds findings to an AuditorStatement. Seeded from audit-finding-templates.json (Awb 4.2 + VNG guidelines); operator-editable per administration.

categoryId.description: Stable category identifier referenced by AuditorStatement.findings[].categoryId.
categoryId.title: Category ID

severity.description: Default severity for findings in this category.
severity.title: Severity

defaultRemediationTemplate.description: Default remediation text proposed when the auditor selects this category.
defaultRemediationTemplate.title: Default Remediation Template

administrationId.description: Optional FK to the Administration owning an operator-customised override; null for the bundled defaults.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Subsidie Verantwoording is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

SubsidieVerantwoording.title: Subsidie Verantwoording
SubsidieVerantwoording.description: Accountability record (verantwoording) for a Subsidie grant per Awb 4.2. Auto-generated in draft on grant award/disbursement, submitted for approval, approved (gated when a blocking AuditorStatement exists on a large grant: ), and finalised. Distinct from the Subsidie grant master it references via grantId.

grantId.description: FK to the Subsidie grant master (Subsidie.subsidieNumber).
grantId.title: Grant ID

reportDate.description: Date the accountability report was generated.
reportDate.title: Report Date

reportingPeriod.description: Period covered, auto-calculated from grant award date to report date.
reportingPeriod.title: Reporting Period

submittedDate.description: Date the report was submitted for approval.
submittedDate.title: Submitted Date

approverUserId.description: User (finance officer) who approved the report.
approverUserId.title: Approver User ID

reportContent.description: Full text or summary of the accountability narrative.
reportContent.title: Report Content

awardedAmount.description: Awarded amount snapshot copied from the Subsidie grant, used to evaluate the auditor threshold without a cross-schema join at transition time.
awardedAmount.title: Awarded Amount

awardDate.description: Grant award date snapshot copied from the Subsidie grant at verantwoording creation, used by the isOverdue calculation to evaluate the 90-day accountability deadline without a cross-schema join at evaluation time. Null on records created before this field existed; isOverdue treats a null awardDate as never-overdue rather than guessing a fallback date.
awardDate.title: Award Date

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this record.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

retention.description: Subsidie verantwoording records retained 10 years after vaststelling per Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable accountability report; auto-generated on grant award/disbursement.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Approved by the finance officer. Approval is blocked while a large grant has a non-approved AuditorStatement.

submit.label: Submit for Approval
submit.description: Operator submits the draft report for finance-officer approval. Audit-logged.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: Finance officer approves. Gated when the grant is above the auditor threshold and its AuditorStatement is not yet approved/conditional. No app-local approval table (ADR-022).

finalize.label: Finalize
finalize.description: Publish the approved accountability report; timestamp recorded.

resubmit.label: Re-submit
resubmit.description: Resubmission when corrections are needed after finalisation.

daysSinceAward.description: Elapsed whole days since the grant award date. Null when awardDate is not set, which flows through to isOverdue resolving false (diffDays returns null on an unparseable/missing operand; gt(null, 90) is false) rather than guessing a fallback reference date.

isOverdue.description: True when this accountability report is in a non-final state (draft/submitted/approved) and more than 90 days have elapsed since the grant award date: the declarative restoration of the retired OverdueVerantwoordingJob:isOverdue rule. Materialised so the onOverdue scheduled notification can filter on it, and re-evaluated daily without an object write by OpenRegister's TemporalCalculationSweepJob (daysSinceAward references `now`, which flags this schema as temporal); `final` is declared as x-openregister-lifecycle's terminal state so already-finalised records are excluded from the sweep.

onSubmitted.description: Notify the finance officer when an accountability report is ready for approval (ADR-031).

subject.nl: Subsidieverantwoording {{verantwoordingId}} is ingediend en wacht op goedkeuring
subject.en: Grant accountability report {{verantwoordingId}} is submitted and awaiting approval

onApproved.description: Notify the grant owner when the accountability report is approved (ADR-031).

onFinal.description: Notify the grant owner when the accountability report is finalised (ADR-031).

onOverdue.description: Daily reminder to the assigned approver while an accountability report remains overdue: restores the retired OverdueVerantwoordingJob's 24h re-check cadence declaratively (ADR-031). Skips records with no assigned approverUserId, matching the job's original behaviour: the `field` recipient kind resolves an empty field value to zero recipients.

subject.nl: Subsidieverantwoording {{verantwoordingId}} is te laat voor goedkeuring (subsidie {{grantId}})
subject.en: Grant accountability report {{verantwoordingId}} is overdue for approval (grant {{grantId}})

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of an Auditor Statement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

AuditorStatement.title: Auditor Statement
AuditorStatement.description: Auditor verification record for a large Subsidie grant (>= configurable threshold, default EUR 25k) per SISA + Awb 4.2. Auto-created in pending when a SubsidieVerantwoording is created for a grant above the threshold; auditor accepts (under-review), then approves / rejects / approves-conditionally.

grantId.description: FK to the Subsidie grant master (Subsidie.subsidieNumber).
grantId.title: Grant ID

auditThresholdApplied.description: Whether the grant exceeded the auditor threshold and verification is mandatory.
auditThresholdApplied.title: Audit Threshold Applied

findings.description: Audit findings: FK to audit-finding-template categoryId plus per-finding notes and resolution status.

severity.description: Severity copied from the template at selection time; operator may override.
severity.title: Severity

note.description: Auditor free-text note for this finding.
note.title: Note

resolution.description: Per-finding resolution status. All findings must be resolved (or none present) before approval.
resolution.title: Resolution

findings.title: Findings

attestationDocumentUri.description: URI to the docudesk PDF of the auditor sign-off. The file lives in docudesk; no blob embedded (ADR-022).
attestationDocumentUri.title: Attestation Document URI

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this record.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

retention.description: Auditor statements retained 10 years per Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020.

pending.label: Pending
pending.description: Auto-created when a SubsidieVerantwoording is created for a large grant. Awaiting auditor acceptance.

under-review.label: Under Review
under-review.description: Auditor has accepted the task and is verifying.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Auditor signed off; grant settlement may proceed.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: Auditor identified blocking issues; grant settlement is blocked.

conditional.label: Conditional
conditional.description: Auditor approved with caveats; SubsidieVerantwoording may proceed with a compliance flag.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: Auditor signs off and uploads the attestation document. Requires no findings, or all findings resolved.

reject.label: Reject
reject.description: Auditor identifies issues and blocks grant settlement.

conditional.label: Approve with Caveats
conditional.description: Auditor approves with caveats requiring follow-up.

onUnderReview.description: Notify the grant owner when the auditor accepts the verification task (ADR-031).

subject.nl: Accountantsverklaring {{statementId}} is in behandeling genomen door de accountant
subject.en: Auditor statement {{statementId}} has been accepted and is now under review

onApproved.description: Notify the grant owner of auditor approval (ADR-031).

onRejected.description: Notify the grant owner of auditor rejection (ADR-031).

subject.nl: Accountantsverklaring {{statementId}} is afgekeurd; de subsidievaststelling is geblokkeerd
subject.en: Auditor statement {{statementId}} is rejected; grant settlement is blocked

onConditional.description: Notify the grant owner of conditional auditor approval (ADR-031).

subject.en: Auditor statement {{statementId}} is conditionally approved, with caveats
